errors.description: The proof gives the wrong sign for the square of the predual map. From J* = L_i and L_i² = -I, duality implies (J²)* = -I and therefore J² = -I, not J² = I. The printed conclusion contradicts the required criterion for a complex structure.
errors.evidence: “It is easy to see by duality theory that J² = I (since (J²)* = -I).”
